newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Basketball-Shell avenge, take 2-1 lead in finals.
newsitem.headline: Basketball-Shell avenge, take 2-1 lead in finals.

text.p: Shell import Ken Redfield led his team to a 85-77 victory against Alaska Milk in the third game of the Philippine Basketball Association second conference finals on Sunday.
Redfield scored 35 points, including a three-point shot in the last minute of the game to end Alaska's hopes for a win.
The teams battled ferociously in the first three quarters, but Shell overpowered Alaska players who tied the series last Sunday by subduing Redfield.
"I didn't even have to tell him what to do. He knows what our game plan is. That's Ken Redfield for you," Shell coach Chito Narvasa said after the game.
The fourth game in the best-of-seven series is scheduled for Tuesday.
